transcript: Speaker A: Dikhta nahi hai kya? Meri gaadi pe dent aa gaya toh tum theek karwaoge? [Can't you see? If my car gets a dent, will you fix it?] Speaker B: First, you learn to drive properly. You ran into me. I could get injured. Speaker A: Are tumne itni acchi English bolna kahan se seekha? [Oh, where did you learn to speak such good English?] Speaker B: Main English Seekho app se seekh raha hoon. App mein roz videos dekhta hoon jo daily-use English sahi grammar ke saath sikhate hain. Aur AI ke saath chat par bolkar aur likhkar practice karta hoon. [I learn from the English Seekho app. I watch daily videos for practical English and practice speaking/writing with AI.] Speaker A: Darr nahi lagta ki koi hasega? [Aren't you afraid people will laugh?] Speaker B: Nahi, AI mazaak nahi udata, sikhata hai. [No, AI doesn't mock, it teaches.] Speaker A: Tumhari English toh mujhse bhi acchi ho gayi. [Your English is better than mine.] Speaker B: Aap Instagram par reels dekhte hain, main English Seekho par seekhta hoon. [You watch reels, I learn on English Seekho.] Speaker A: Yeh toh mehanga hoga? [Isn't it expensive?] Speaker B: Bas ek rupaye mein teen din ka trial hai. Install button pe click karo. [Just 1 rupee for a 3-day trial. Click install.] Voiceover: Install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [Click install and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: Hindi subtitles translating the dialogue. End card: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW. Disclaimer text at the bottom.
summary: A car driver gets into an argument with a vegetable vendor, who responds in fluent English. The vendor explains he uses the English Seekho app to practice with AI instead of wasting time on social media. The ad promotes a 3-day trial for 1 rupee and prompts users to install the app.
